en.name: English
en.hintRotate: Drag to turn. What can you see?
en.stageHint: Drag to turn, spread to open, tap a seed.
en.noWebGL: Try the picture below. You can still open the fruit and find its seeds.
en.treeHint: Give the tree a little shake. Then choose a fruit.
en.title: Hello, little pear.
en.subtitle: A little pear, a whole world to explore.

facts.title: Skin
facts.text: A thin jacket. Pears can be green, yellow or brown.

facts.title: Core and seeds
facts.text: Small seeds sit inside the core.

story.title: First, a blossom
story.text: A flower can become a little pear.

story.title: Time to grow
story.text: The tiny pear grows bigger on its branch.

story.title: To the kitchen
story.text: Ask a grown-up to wash and cut it.

en.origin: Pear trees grow in many places with cool winters.
en.modelNote: A play model with five seeds. Real pears vary in shape and seed count; some are round.

ko.name: 한국어
ko.stageHint: 밀어서 돌리고, 벌려서 열고, 씨앗을 눌러요.
ko.noWebGL: 아래 그림으로 놀아봐요. 과일을 벌리고 씨앗을 찾을 수 있어요.
ko.treeHint: 나무를 살짝 흔들어봐요. 그리고 과일을 골라요.
ko.title: 안녕, 작은 배야.
ko.subtitle: 작은 배 속에 어떤 세상이 있을까요?

facts.title: 껍질
facts.text: 얇은 겉옷이에요. 초록색, 노란색, 갈색 배가 있어요.

facts.title: 심과 씨앗
facts.text: 가운데 심 안에 작은 씨앗이 있어요.

story.title: 먼저 꽃이 피어요
story.text: 꽃에서 작은 배가 생길 수 있어요.

ko.origin: 배나무는 겨울이 서늘한 세계 여러 곳에서 자라요.
ko.modelNote: 씨앗 5개가 있는 놀이 모형이에요. 실제 배는 모양과 씨앗 수가 달라요. 동그란 배도 있어요!

es.name: Español
es.stageHint: Arrastra para girar, separa para abrir y toca una semilla.
es.noWebGL: Prueba el dibujo de abajo. Puedes abrir la fruta y buscar sus semillas.
es.treeHint: Mueve un poco el árbol. Después elige una fruta.
es.title: Hola, pequeña pera.
es.subtitle: Una pequeña pera, todo un mundo por explorar.

facts.title: Piel
facts.text: Una capa fina. Hay peras verdes, amarillas o marrones.

facts.title: Pulpa
facts.text: La parte clara y jugosa del interior.

facts.title: Corazón y semillas
facts.text: Las pequeñas semillas están en el corazón.

story.title: Primero, una flor
story.text: Una flor puede convertirse en una pera.

story.title: A crecer
story.text: La pera se hace más grande en su rama.

story.title: A la cocina
story.text: Pide a una persona adulta que la lave y corte.

es.origin: Los perales crecen en muchos lugares con inviernos frescos.
es.modelNote: Un modelo con cinco semillas. Las peras reales tienen distintas formas y cantidades de semillas. ¡Algunas son redondas!
